policy: Official Honda Automobiles U.S., Honda Info Center and Honda Owners warranty sources only. Missing or non-applicable values are explicitly labelled; no values are inferred.

brand_fields.warranty: 3 years/36,000 miles New Vehicle Limited Warranty and 5 years/60,000 miles Powertrain Limited Warranty; hybrid/high-voltage battery coverage varies by powertrain and applicable warranty booklet.

CR-V.engine: 1.5L turbocharged inline-4 on LX/EX/EX-L; 2.0L Atkinson-cycle inline-4 with Honda two-motor hybrid system on hybrid trims
CR-V.horsepower: 190 hp on 1.5L turbo trims; 204 hp total system output on hybrid trims
CR-V.torque: 179 lb-ft on 1.5L turbo trims; hybrid electric drive motor rated at 247 lb-ft
CR-V.transmission: Continuously Variable Transmission on 1.5L turbo trims; Direct Drive Unit on two-motor hybrid trims
CR-V.efficiency: 2027 EPA ratings: gas 2WD up to 28/33/30 mpg city/highway/combined; hybrid 2WD up to 43/36/40 mpg; hybrid AWD up to 40/34/37 mpg, with TrailSport Hybrid rated 38/33/35 mpg
CR-V.dimensions: 184.8 in L × 73.5 in W × 66.2 in H (2WD) or 66.5 in H (AWD); 106.3 in wheelbase
CR-V.cargo: Gas trims: 39.3 cu ft behind second row and up to 76.5 cu ft max; most hybrid trims: 36.3 cu ft behind second row and up to 71.8 cu ft max
CR-V.towing: 1,500 lb on gas trims; 1,000 lb on hybrid trims
CR-V.technology: 9-in color touchscreen, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, wireless phone charging; Google built-in available on upper trims
CR-V.safety: Honda Sensing suite includes Collision Mitigation Braking System, Road Departure Mitigation, Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow, Lane Keeping Assist and Traffic Sign Recognition; additional blind-spot, cross-traffic and parking features vary by trim

Accord.engine: 1.5L turbocharged inline-4 on LX/SE; 2.0L Atkinson-cycle inline-4 with two-motor hybrid system on Sport Hybrid and above
Accord.horsepower: 192 hp on 1.5L turbo trims; 204 hp total system output on hybrid trims
Accord.torque: 192 lb-ft on 1.5L turbo trims; hybrid electric drive motor rated at 247 lb-ft
Accord.transmission: Continuously Variable Transmission on 1.5L turbo trims; Direct Drive Unit on hybrid trims
Accord.efficiency: 2026 EPA ratings span 28-29 city / 36-37 highway / 31-32 combined mpg on turbo trims and 46-51 city / 41-44 highway / 44-48 combined mpg on hybrid trims
Accord.dimensions: 195.7 in L × 73.3 in W × 57.1 in H; 111.4 in wheelbase
Accord.technology: 9-in color touchscreen on turbo trims and 12.3-in color touchscreen on hybrid trims; wireless smartphone integration, with Google built-in on Touring Hybrid
Accord.safety: Honda Sensing driver-assist suite includes Collision Mitigation Braking System, Road Departure Mitigation, Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow, Lane Keeping Assist and Traffic Sign Recognition; Blind Spot Information is available on most trims above LX

Civic Sedan.engine: 2.0L Atkinson-cycle inline-4; hybrid trims pair the engine with Honda's two-motor hybrid system
Civic Sedan.horsepower: 150 hp on LX/Sport; 200 hp total system output on Sport Hybrid and Sport Touring Hybrid
Civic Sedan.torque: 133 lb-ft on non-hybrid trims; hybrid electric drive motor rated at 232 lb-ft
Civic Sedan.transmission: Continuously Variable Transmission on LX/Sport; Direct Drive Unit on hybrid trims
Civic Sedan.efficiency: 2026 EPA ratings: LX 32/41/36 mpg, Sport 31/39/34 mpg, and hybrid trims 50/47/49 mpg city/highway/combined
Civic Sedan.dimensions: 184.8 in L × 70.9 in W × 55.7 in H; 107.7 in wheelbase
Civic Sedan.technology: Wireless smartphone integration is available by trim, with Google built-in on Sport Touring Hybrid and digital/connected features varying by grade
Civic Sedan.safety: Honda Sensing includes Forward Collision Warning, Lane Departure Warning, Collision Mitigation Braking System, Road Departure Mitigation, Lane Keeping Assist, Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow, Traffic Sign Recognition and Traffic Jam Assist; blind-spot and parking features vary by trim

Pilot.transmission: 10-speed automatic transmission with Shift-By-Wire and paddle shifters
Pilot.efficiency: 2026 EPA ratings: up to 19/27/22 mpg city/highway/combined in 2WD, 19/25/21 mpg in mainstream AWD configurations, and 18/23/20 mpg on TrailSport
Pilot.dimensions: 200.1-200.4 in L × 78.5 in W × 70.9-72.0 in H depending on trim; 113.8 in wheelbase
Pilot.cargo: Up to 113.7 cu ft maximum cargo volume depending on trim; 18.6 cu ft standard behind the third row on listed configurations
Pilot.towing: Up to 3,500 lb on 2WD configurations and 5,000 lb on AWD configurations
Pilot.technology: 12.3-in color touchscreen available across the current lineup, with wireless smartphone integration and Google built-in on supported trims
Pilot.safety: Honda Sensing includes Collision Mitigation Braking System, Road Departure Mitigation, Forward Collision Warning, Lane Departure Warning, Lane Keeping Assist, Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow, Traffic Sign Recognition and Traffic Jam Assist; additional blind-spot and parking systems vary by trim

Passport.transmission: 10-speed automatic transmission with Shift-By-Wire and paddle shifters; second-generation i-VTM4 AWD standard
Passport.efficiency: 2026 EPA ratings: 19/25/21 mpg city/highway/combined on RTL configurations and 18/23/20 mpg on TrailSport-family configurations
Passport.dimensions: 191.5 in L × 79.4 in W × 73.1 in H; 113.6 in wheelbase; 8.3 in ground clearance
Passport.cargo: 44.0 cu ft behind the second row; up to about 104.6 cu ft maximum behind the first row depending on configuration
Passport.technology: 12.3-in color touchscreen, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, wireless phone charger and Google built-in
Passport.safety: Honda Sensing and active-safety equipment include Collision Mitigation Braking System with advanced pedestrian detection, Road Departure Mitigation, Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow, Lane Keeping Assist, blind-spot monitoring and parking-assist features by trim
